intro.title: Turn a Portrait and Voice Clip Into a Talking Avatar

content.title: What it does
content.text: This tool turns one portrait image and one uploaded voice clip into a short presenter-style video. The audio drives the speaking timing, while your direction prompt guides expression, eye contact, head movement, lighting, and background feel.

content.title: When it works best
content.text: Use it for a single speaker, a clear face, and a focused message. It is a strong fit for short introductions, explainers, onboarding clips, course previews, and personalized outreach.

content.title: What to prepare
content.text: Choose a front-facing portrait with the mouth visible, then upload a clean voice recording from one speaker. Short clips with low background noise are easier to review and refine.

faq.q: What is an AI talking avatar creator?
faq.a: It creates a short speaking video from a portrait image and an audio file. The audio drives speech timing while the prompt controls expression and presentation style.
Use a clear front-facing portrait with good lighting and an unobstructed mouth. Avoid side profiles, sunglasses, heavy blur, or tightly cropped faces.
Use one short speech recording with a single speaker and low background noise. MP3, WAV, M4A, and OGG files are supported.

faq.q: Can I use my own voice?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a voice audio file you have the rights to use. Short, clean speech with one speaker usually gives better lip sync.
Use 480p to review speech timing and facial motion quickly. Choose 720p when you are ready for a sharper version of the same short talking avatar clip.

faq.q: How is this different from image-to-video generation?
faq.a: Talking Avatar Creator is for a portrait that speaks to a supplied voice clip. Image-to-video generation is better when the main goal is broader motion or camera movement from a still image.
